title: Clarify page field caption and tooltip inheritance
summary: Knowledge articles now state that bound page fields inherit Caption and, from BC24 runtime 13.0, ToolTip from their source table fields. Agents should inspect source fields before flagging missing properties, which avoids redundant page-level captions and tooltips.
key_points: Recognizes caption inheritance from table fields to bound page fields
Documents tooltip inheritance from BC24 runtime 13.0 onwards
Removes redundant recommendations for caption and tooltip on inherited bound fields
Updates good and bad AL examples with accurate scenarios
Requires source field inspection before reporting missing properties
